senses.gloss: (b. h.) [to strike, beat; cmp. Lat. plango,] to lament, mourn.
units: <cite ref="Gittin 57a:16">Gitt. 57ᵃ</cite> <he>סִיפְדוּ לזה</he> mourn for this man.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 47a">Snh. 47ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>אל תִּסְפְּדוּנִי וכ׳</he> do not hold services for me in the towns; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to arrange funeral or memorial services for; to lament, eulogise.
units: M. Kat. I, 5 ולא יַסְפִּידֶנּוּ קידם וכ׳ and must not engage a safdan (eulogist) for him thirty days before a festival.

<cite ref="Megillah 28b:1">Meg. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>אין מַסְפִּידִין בהן וכ׳</he> no funeral services for an individual must be held in them (the synagogues); <he>ומספידין … רבים</he> but you may use them for funeral services in cases of public mourning (for a distinguished person).

<cite ref="Tractate Semachot 3:4">Treat. S’maḥ. III, 4</cite> <he>מספידין לעניים וכ׳</he> mourning services are held for children of poor men at the age of three, for those of rich men at the age of four years.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 21b:5">M. Kat. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>והִסְפִּידוּם הספד גדול</he> and they arranged a great lamentation over them (the sons of R. ‘Aḳiba); a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 47a:4">Snh. 47ᵃ</cite> <he>מת לא נ׳ וכ׳</he> a dead not mourned for and not buried.
<cite ref="Yevamot 78b">Yeb. 78ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא נ׳ כהלכה</he> no appropriate lamentations were held over his remains; a. e.
